# External research imports

This directory records important work developed outside `GettysburgResearch/collatz` when it is useful to the repository's active mathematical programs.

An external import is **not** an integrated resident proof packet. It preserves the source statement, exact provenance, evidence claims, local audit boundary, and proposed repository connections without silently promoting an outside theorem to repository-verified status.

Status vocabulary:

- **EXTERNAL SOURCE-QUALIFIED** — the theorem and evidence are pinned to an outside source; this repository has not yet independently reconstructed the whole proof or replayed every large artifact.
- **LOCALLY AUDITED (PARTIAL)** — the manuscript was read in full and specified lightweight checks were performed, but the audit is narrower than an independent end-to-end proof review.
- **PROPOSED CONNECTION** — a new synthesis, conditional bridge, or research direction that still needs narrow mathematical review.

Current imports:

- [`mazur-2026/`](mazur-2026/README.md) — Lech Mazur's July 2026 formally checked predecessor-set and natural-density/logarithmic-time Collatz results, with exact PDF fingerprints, source pins, claim matrix, local checks, repository crosswalk, and a quantitative bridge program.
